notes: Added missing core logic normalization, signal-to-explainability mapping, and frontend display helper.

stories.title: Explainability Normalization Engine
stories.description: Implement core backend logic to normalize raw evaluation signals (credentials, links, trials) into the standardized explainability schema, including default fallbacks for missing fields and consistent wording patterns.

stories.title: Signal-to-Explainability Mapping Rules
stories.description: Define and implement deterministic mapping rules that translate each evaluation signal type (e.g., license status, trial phase) into human-readable meaning and limitations fields.

stories.title: Frontend Explainability Rendering Helper
stories.description: Add a frontend utility/helper to consistently render explainability objects within chat responses, ensuring structured display of source, meaning, and limitations with safe markdown handling.
